title: Between Randomness and Arbitrariness: Some Lessons for Reliable Machine Learning at Scale

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) and False Negative Rate (FNR) disparities, as well as a novel self-consistency metric (predictive variance), across racial groups (e.g., White vs. Non-white) using bootstrapped model ensembles on datasets like COMPAS, New Adult, and HMDA.

Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) and False Negative Rate (FNR) disparities, as well as a novel self-consistency metric (predictive variance), across male and female subgroups using bootstrapped model ensembles on datasets like Old Adult, New Adult, South German Credit, Taiwan Credit, and HMDA.

Evaluating False Positive Rate (FPR) and False Negative Rate (FNR) disparities, as well as a novel self-consistency metric (predictive variance), across Hispanic/Latino and Non-Hispanic/Latino subgroups using bootstrapped model ensembles on the HMDA dataset.
